lines.zh: 我一步一步踩进河泥，声音很闷。
lines.en: I step into the river mud with a muffled thud.

lines.zh: 河马走路不看脚下，我懒得看。
lines.en: I don't watch my feet; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 我的肚子擦过水草，草就倒了。
lines.en: My belly brushes the reeds and they fall.

lines.zh: 四条腿很短，撑起的身子很沉。
lines.en: Four short legs holding up a heavy body.

lines.zh: 我上岸吃草，走得不快。
lines.en: I come ashore to graze, taking my time.

lines.zh: 泥从我背上往下淌。
lines.en: Mud slides down my back in slow runs.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸转，那条路是我踩的。
lines.en: I follow the bank path my own feet made.

lines.zh: 耳朵转了一下，赶走一只苍蝇。
lines.en: One ear flicks to chase a fly away.

lines.zh: 我踩塌了一小片芦苇。
lines.en: I flattened a small patch of reeds.

lines.zh: 水只到我的膝盖，我照样走。
lines.en: The water only reaches my knees; I wade on.

lines.zh: 我往前走，鸟就往两边散。
lines.en: Birds scatter to either side as I move.

lines.zh: 这块石头被我一脚踢开了。
lines.en: One kick and that stone rolled away.

lines.zh: 我停下来喘，喘声比脚步响。
lines.en: I stop to breathe; it's louder than my steps.

lines.zh: 回水里那一下，最舒服。
lines.en: The slide back into water feels best.

lines.zh: 我从深水走上沙洲，水滴成线。
lines.en: I climb from deep water onto the sandbar, dripping.

lines.zh: 我抬腿跨过倒下的树干。
lines.en: I lift a leg over a fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 我只把眼睛和鼻孔露出水面。
lines.en: Only my eyes and nostrils break the surface.

lines.zh: 我打哈欠，嘴能张到很夸张。
lines.en: I yawn, and my mouth opens absurdly wide.

lines.zh: 我在泥里打滚，凉快得很。
lines.en: I roll in the mud and it cools me.

lines.zh: 一只白鹭站在我背上，我不在意。
lines.en: An egret stands on my back; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我的皮会渗出红色的汗。
lines.en: My hide oozes a sweat that looks red.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像块河里的石头。
lines.en: I stay still as a boulder in the river.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，水面冒出泡。
lines.en: I grunt and bubbles rise to the surface.

lines.zh: 太阳太晒，我往水里沉一寸。
lines.en: Too much sun; I sink an inch deeper.

lines.zh: 嘴里还有草，我慢慢嚼。
lines.en: Grass is still in my mouth; I chew slowly.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴甩一下，赶蚊子。
lines.en: My tail swings once to chase the mosquitoes.

lines.zh: 河面很平，我在下面打盹。
lines.en: The river is flat; I doze underneath.

lines.zh: 有鱼在我腿间游过，随它去。
lines.en: A fish swims between my legs; let it.

lines.zh: 我张嘴让小鸟进来啄虫。
lines.en: I open my mouth and let the birds pick.

lines.zh: 这片河湾的水温，我记了十年。
lines.en: I've known this bay's water for ten years.

lines.zh: 水草贴在背上，我懒得理会。
lines.en: Weeds cling to my back. I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我半睁着眼，看云慢慢挪。
lines.en: Half-lidded, I watch the clouds creep along.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，比我的腿还短。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, shorter than my leg.

lines.zh: 我眯眼看你，鼻孔喷了口气。
lines.en: I squint at you and my nostrils puff.

lines.zh: 你的船靠近了，我抬起耳朵。
lines.en: Your boat comes close; my ears lift.

lines.zh: 你手里的西瓜，我早看见了。
lines.en: I saw that watermelon in your hands already.

lines.zh: 我在水下看你，你只看水面。
lines.en: I watch from below while you watch the surface.

lines.zh: 这地方我占了很久，你也想站？
lines.en: I've held this spot long; you want it too?

lines.zh: 你举起相机，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: You raise a camera; I don't care for it.

lines.zh: 你慢慢退，我就不动。
lines.en: Back away slowly and I won't move.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在头顶，正好看你。
lines.en: My eyes sit high, right where I need them.

lines.zh: 你说话的时候，我打了个哈欠。
lines.en: While you talk, I yawn at you.

lines.zh: 你身上带着草叶的气味。
lines.en: You carry the smell of crushed leaves.

lines.zh: 我把头转开，表示不想聊。
lines.en: I turn my head away to end the talk.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，水都震了。
lines.en: I grunt and the water shivers.

lines.zh: 这伤口在我背上，不碍事。
lines.en: The wound is on my back; it's nothing.

lines.zh: 你打疼我了，我要认真了。
lines.en: That hurt; now I'll stop being gentle.

lines.zh: 我转身太快，溅了你一身水。
lines.en: I turned fast and soaked you.

lines.zh: 我皮厚，这一下只到脂肪。
lines.en: My hide is thick; that only reached fat.

lines.zh: 我沉进水里，伤口凉下来。
lines.en: I sink and the water cools the sting.

lines.zh: 别再来第二下，我不保证。
lines.en: Don't try a second hit; I can't promise.

lines.zh: 我退到河中央，那里安全。
lines.en: I retreat to midriver where it's safe.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我只会往前冲。
lines.en: When hurt, I only know how to charge.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，喘得很响。
lines.en: I lower my head and breathe loudly.

lines.zh: 整个西瓜，一口就没了。
lines.en: A whole watermelon, gone in one bite.

lines.zh: 你抱着瓜过来，我站起来等你。
lines.en: You bring the melon and I rise to meet you.

lines.zh: 瓜皮别剥，我爱啃那层硬的。
lines.en: Leave the rind on; I like the tough part.

lines.zh: 甜的东西我不常吃到。
lines.en: Sweet things don't come my way often.

lines.zh: 你先扔一个，我看看真假。
lines.en: Toss one first and I'll judge it.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张开了，你放进来就行。
lines.en: My mouth is open; just put it in.

lines.zh: 一整个不够，得三个。
lines.en: One isn't enough; make it three.

lines.zh: 瓜汁顺着我下巴往下淌。
lines.en: Melon juice runs down my chin.

lines.zh: 你手别伸太近，我的牙大。
lines.en: Don't reach too close; my teeth are big.

lines.zh: 我吃完，会把瓜皮吐出来。
lines.en: I'll spit the rind out when I'm done.

lines.zh: 你带来的瓜，比河边的草好吃。
lines.en: Your melon beats the riverside grass.

lines.zh: 我闻见甜味就忘了刚才在生气。
lines.en: The sweet smell erased my earlier temper.

lines.zh: 放在石头上，我自己去拿。
lines.en: Set it on the rock; I'll take it myself.

lines.zh: 明天还带瓜来，我就认得你。
lines.en: Bring melon tomorrow and I'll know you.

lines.zh: 你切开的瓜，我闻见更甜。
lines.en: The cut melon smells sweeter to me.

lines.zh: 我拱你的手，催你快些放下。
lines.en: I nudge your hand, urging you to put it down.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我几乎没动。
lines.en: You bumped into me and I barely shifted.

lines.zh: 我的皮很厚，你的肩膀会疼。
lines.en: My hide is thick; your shoulder will ache.

lines.zh: 退开，这块泥滩是我的。
lines.en: Back off; this mudflat is mine.

lines.zh: 我把你顶开，只用了半边身子。
lines.en: I shoved you aside with half my body.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴了，快松脚。
lines.en: You're on my tail; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 我挪一挪，你就有了路。
lines.en: I shift a little and you have a path.

lines.zh: 这一侧不许站，去另一边。
lines.en: Not that side; go around the other way.

lines.zh: 泥地被我们俩踩得稀烂。
lines.en: Between us we've churned the mud.

lines.zh: 我打个响鼻，不是要咬你。
lines.en: That snort was a warning, not a bite.

lines.zh: 挤不过我就绕，别硬来。
lines.en: If you can't shove past, go around.

lines.zh: 她的嘴比我的还大一点。
lines.en: Her mouth is a little wider than mine.

lines.zh: 我们在同一个河湾里泡着。
lines.en: We soak in the same bend of the river.

lines.zh: 我咬着水草递给她。
lines.en: I bite off some reeds and offer them.

lines.zh: 她打个响鼻，我就跟过去。
lines.en: She snorts and I follow her lead.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，谁也不用说话。
lines.en: We stand side by side needing no words.

lines.zh: 小河马会在水里吃奶。
lines.en: Our calf will nurse while half submerged.

lines.zh: 我守着她，谁靠近我就瞪。
lines.en: I guard her and glare at anyone near.

lines.zh: 她的皮上有旧伤，我不去碰。
lines.en: She has old scars; I leave them be.

lines.zh: 河湾太挤，我们换一处。
lines.en: This bay is crowded; we'll find another.

lines.zh: 我们一起沉下去，只留鼻孔。
lines.en: We sink together, only nostrils out.

lines.zh: 我咬起你掉的帽子，还你。
lines.en: I lift your dropped hat and return it.

lines.zh: 这块瓜皮我含着，不扔。
lines.en: I'll hold this rind and not drop it.

lines.zh: 我把木头推到岸边。
lines.en: I push the log toward the bank.

lines.zh: 嘴里叼着东西，我说话含糊。
lines.en: With something in my mouth, I mumble.

lines.zh: 你掉进水里的桨，我捞了。
lines.en: I fished out the oar you dropped.

lines.zh: 我用嘴捡，前腿不灵便。
lines.en: I pick things up by mouth; my forelegs are clumsy.

lines.zh: 这块石头太滑，含不住。
lines.en: This stone is too smooth to hold.

lines.zh: 我把它放在你脚边，算还了。
lines.en: I set it by your feet, debt settled.

lines.zh: 水里的东西，我顺手带上来。
lines.en: Whatever's in the river, I bring up.

lines.zh: 别放太小的，我的牙缝大。
lines.en: Don't give me small things; my teeth have gaps.

lines.zh: 河对岸有片新草，我要去。
lines.en: New grass across the river; I'm going.

lines.zh: 那头鳄鱼进我的水域了。
lines.en: That crocodile entered my stretch of water.

lines.zh: 瓜田的香味，我隔岸都闻到。
lines.en: I smell the melon field across the water.

lines.zh: 有船靠得太近，我盯住了。
lines.en: A boat came too close; I'm watching it.

lines.zh: 那片芦苇后面有动静。
lines.en: Something moves behind those reeds.

lines.zh: 水浅了，我准备换个深坑。
lines.en: The water's low; I'll find a deeper pool.

lines.zh: 岸上有人搬瓜，我看见了。
lines.en: Someone's carrying melons ashore; I see them.

lines.zh: 我的河湾，今天不欢迎客人。
lines.en: My bay is closed to visitors today.

lines.zh: 那棵倒下的树，正好挡路。
lines.en: That fallen tree is blocking my route.

lines.zh: 有东西在水下拖我的腿。
lines.en: Something is dragging at my leg underwater.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，只留一条水纹。
lines.en: I submerge, leaving only a ripple.

lines.zh: 我不急，等它再靠近些。
lines.en: No hurry; I'll let it come closer.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子先出水，试试方向。
lines.en: My nose breaks the surface to test the air.

lines.zh: 它顺着河岸走，我从水里跟。
lines.en: It follows the bank; I track from the river.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张开，慢慢浮上去。
lines.en: I open my mouth and rise slowly.

lines.zh: 河面很宽，它跑不掉。
lines.en: The river is wide; it can't get far.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底走，泥挡住了我。
lines.en: I move along the bottom, mud hiding me.

lines.zh: 它停下来了，我也停。
lines.en: It stopped, so I stopped as well.

lines.zh: 等它低头喝水，我就动。
lines.en: When it lowers its head to drink, I move.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我把身子压低。
lines.en: Close enough; I lower my bulk down.

lines.zh: 我张嘴一咬，船桨断了。
lines.en: I bite once and the oar snaps.

lines.zh: 我不用爪子，牙就够了。
lines.en: I don't need claws; my teeth suffice.

lines.zh: 这一撞能把小船翻过来。
lines.en: One shove can flip a small boat.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把咬住的东西扔出去。
lines.en: I shake my head and fling what I hold.

lines.zh: 你退到岸上，我就不追了。
lines.en: Get onto land and I'll stop chasing.

lines.zh: 我的牙不长，但咬合力可怕。
lines.en: My teeth are short; my jaw is not.

lines.zh: 我压下身子，把你挤进泥里。
lines.en: I bear down and press you into mud.

lines.zh: 水流被我搅得乱七八糟。
lines.en: The river churns where I thrash.

lines.zh: 第一下是警告，别等第二下。
lines.en: The first was a warning; don't wait for two.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，就够得着你。
lines.en: I don't even step forward to reach you.

lines.zh: 我从浅水里站起来，泥往下掉。
lines.en: I rise from the shallows, mud sliding off.

lines.zh: 第一口气很长，河面都动了。
lines.en: My first breath is long and stirs the river.

lines.zh: 我还是小家伙，嘴已经很大。
lines.en: I'm still small, though my mouth is not.

lines.zh: 母亲在旁边，水只到她肚子。
lines.en: Mother stands near, water to her belly.

lines.zh: 我试着张嘴，声音把鸟惊走了。
lines.en: I test my voice and the birds flee.

lines.zh: 河泥暖，我趴下来不动。
lines.en: The mud is warm; I lie down and stay.

lines.zh: 这片河湾从今天起有我一份。
lines.en: This bay has my claim from today.

lines.zh: 我还没长牙，只能吃草。
lines.en: No tusks yet; grass is all I manage.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃得我眨眼。
lines.en: The light on the water makes me blink.

lines.zh: 我一步步走进深水，没人教。
lines.en: I wade into deep water; no one taught me.

lines.zh: 皮被烤得发烫，我冲进河里。
lines.en: My hide burned hot; I crashed into the river.

lines.zh: 我摔进浅坑，泥溅得到处是。
lines.en: I fell into a ditch and sprayed mud.

lines.zh: 水太深，我拼命往上游。
lines.en: The water's too deep; I kick for the top.

lines.zh: 响声把我掀翻在水里。
lines.en: The blast knocked me over in the water.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在厚皮上，没进多深。
lines.en: An arrow stuck in my thick hide, shallow.

lines.zh: 光绕着我的头转，我甩不掉。
lines.en: Light circles my head and won't shake off.

lines.zh: 河边的草吃完了，我很饿。
lines.en: The riverside grass is gone and I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 雷劈在河面，我整头扎下去。
lines.en: Lightning hit the river; I plunged under.

lines.zh: 我在掉，河水却不见踪影。
lines.en: I fall where no river runs at all.
